description:
Fetch a file from a public link and add it to a knowledge base: price lists, menus, manuals, policies. PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, CSV or HTML, up to 10 MB; at most 20 documents per knowledge base. Images (JPEG, PNG, up to 5 MB) and videos (MP4, up to 16 MB) can be added too, for agents to send on WhatsApp; they need a description. It comes back processing and is usually ready within seconds (check with get_knowledge_file). Agents using this knowledge base then search it during calls with their built-in search_knowledge tool, and can send it on WhatsApp when their WhatsApp tools are on. This tool cannot upload files; for a file on disk, use the dashboard or the SDKs.

Requires scope `knowledge_bases:write`.

description.description: What it is or shows. Required for an image or video.

name.description: What to call it. Defaults to the file name in the link.

url.description: A public link to the document, e.g. https://example.com/menu.pdf

name: add_knowledge_file
title: Add a document to a knowledge base
